description_sq:
Shesim apartament 2+1 te investuar ne nje godine te re ne Linze, prane Restorant Muraga. Apartamenti ka planimetri te rregullt dhe te ndricuar me drite natyrale.
Organizimi: Ambient ndenje+ gatimi, 2 dhoma gjumi, verande qe aksesohet nga te gjitha ambientet dhe tualet.
Apartameti eshte i investuar, dhe eshte mje mundesi shume e mire banimi.
description_en: We are selling a 2+1 apartment invested in a new building in Linze, near Muraga Restaurant. The apartment has a regular layout and is illuminated with natural light. Organization: Living room + kitchen, 2 bedrooms, veranda accessible from all rooms and toilet. The apartment is invested, and is a very good residential opportunity.
